title: Report on reviewed products
prompt: For every product that has at least 2 reviews, return five columns. name is the product's name. reviews is how many reviews it has. avg_rating is its average rating, rounded to 2 decimal places. units_sold is the total quantity of the product across all order items, or 0 if it was never ordered. verdict is loved when avg_rating is 4.5 or more, mixed when it is 3 or more, and poor otherwise. Put the highest avg_rating first, and sort products with the same avg_rating by name.
hints: Reviews and order items are two separate tables with many rows per product. What happens if both are joined to products at once?
Work out the review numbers in one step and the units in another, each with one row per product_id. Then join them to products.
Keep products with no items by using a LEFT JOIN to the units step and COALESCE. Test the larger limit of the verdict first.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins reviews and order items to products at once, so each repeats the other.
Uses an inner join to the units, which leaves out a reviewed product that never sold.
Tests the lower limit of the verdict first, so nothing is ever loved.
Leaves out the filter, so products with one review are listed.

feedback: Take the first row the failure names and test each of its numbers with a plain query on one table.
